mapper.select:
SELECT C.CAMP_ID AS contentId, C.CAMP_NAME AS facltNm, C.ADDRESS AS addr1, C.LATITUDE AS mapY, C.LONGITUDE AS mapX, C.DESCRIPTION AS lineIntro, C.INDUTY AS induty, COALESCE(MAIN_IMG.IMG_URL, RAND_IMG.IMG_URL) AS firstImageUrl FROM CAMP C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CAMP_ID, MIN(IMG_URL) AS IMG_URL FROM CAMP_IMG WHERE IS_MAIN = 'Y' GROUP BY CAMP_ID ) MAIN_IMG ON C.CAMP_ID = MAIN_IMG.CAMP_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT C2.CAMP_ID, ( SELECT CI.IMG_URL FROM CAMP_IMG CI ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1 ) AS IMG_URL FROM CAMP C2 ) RAND_IMG ON C.CAMP_ID = RAND_IMG.CAMP_ID WHERE 1=1
AND C.ADDRESS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{selectedArea}, '%')
ORDER BY C.CAMP_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CAMP (CAMP_ID, CAMP_NAME, ADDRESS, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, DESCRIPTION, INDUTY) VALUES ( #{item.contentId}, #{item.facltNm}, #{item.addr1}, #{item.mapY}, #{item.mapX}, #{item.lineIntro}, #{item.induty} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ADDRESS = VALUES(ADDRESS), DESCRIPTION = VALUES(DESCRIPTION), INDUTY = VALUES(INDUTY)
INSERT INTO CAMP_IMG (CAMP_ID, IMG_URL, IS_MAIN) VALUES (#{campId}, #{imgUrl}, 'Y') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE IMG_URL = VALUES(IMG_URL)
mapper.select: SELECT CAMP_REVIEW_ID AS CAMP_REVIEW_ID, USER_ID AS userId, CONTENT AS content, RATING AS rating, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt FROM CAMP_REVIEW WHERE CAMP_ID = #{campId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CAMP_REVIEW (CAMP_ID, USER_ID, RATING, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{campId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, NOW())
